test.name: A request to correct family tree information goes straight to the tree-edit agent, not research
test.description: This routing negative asks how to correct information in an existing family tree. The correct first hop is tree-edit because a single tree fix is not on research's bounded list. Routing mode passes only on a spawn of that agent with research never activating, so it measures the agent's description directly.

input.user_message: How do I make an adjustment to my family tree where the information is incorrect?

judge_context: This is a ROUTING negative. The harness grades it in routing mode: it passes only if the main thread spawns @plugin:tree-edit and research never activates. Do not grade the routing decision yourself; your scores are diagnostic only.
A project exists; the message asks for a single tree fix, which the tree-edit agent does.

negative.explanation: Ruling 2026-10-27: for this message the main thread's correct first hop is the tree-edit agent itself, not research. A single tree fix is not on research's closed bounded list (research/SKILL.md, "Bounded request or job"), so research capturing this message would run it as a job. A miss is recorded, never made green by adding grade_on_invariant or widening correct_skill.
